A FEW THINGS WORTH KNOWING

Before the
first serve.

Is the editor really free?+

Yes. The official local editor has unlimited exports, with no Roundnet watermarks or forced promotional content. The project-authored code is MIT licensed. Optional future support or services will not be required for local clean exports.

How does automatic rally detection work?+

It combines computer vision, motion, audio, and body-pose cues with scoring rules to suggest rally boundaries. It needs your review and can miss plays or include false detections. Outcomes and player identities are entered by you. Real-game accuracy has not yet been established on a labeled benchmark.

What do I need to run it?+

The editor currently targets macOS and uses a developer setup with Python and FFmpeg. The browser interface also uses Node.js. The setup guide covers installation. A packaged desktop installer is not available yet.

Can I use it from my phone?+

You can review and edit in your phone’s browser while it is connected to the Mac on the same trusted Wi-Fi. The Mac runs the editor and renders the video. This is a companion browser workflow, rather than a standalone iPhone app.

Can I add my own scoreboard and branding?+

Yes. Include the built-in scoreboard, stats end card, and captions if you want them, and supply a PNG for your own team or sponsor graphic. Those elements are optional. A clean export carries no required Roundnet branding.
